cheng: quick async for my shift wrap-up — SLOs: saw a p99 latency spike around 11:10 UTC (batching backlog). Alerts: two p95 alerts on /generate between 11:05–11:25. Oncall follow-ups: jack is already looking at traces. Reliability work: I cleared one stuck batcher pod and queued a rolling restart plan for the batcher fleet at 14:00 UTC.

What I did: checked dashboards, cleared node-7 stuck job (killed and rescheduled), validated no token leaks in logs. Blockers: can't reproduce the long-tail locally, need a trace sample with logs. Today: coordinate canary restart, prepare rollback steps, short post-restart smoke. Any concerns or do we proceed with a small canary at 14:00?

jack: digging into traces now. I see tail latency correlates with kv-evict spikes — there are several requests waiting on eviction lock. Pushed a temporary tail-sampler to capture full spans. Will post trace link in a min.

riley: +1 to canary restart. I'll own the monitoring dashboard during the window and keep a quick pager on for 15m after canary. I'll also watch SLOs and error rates. :eyes:

priya: can we canary to 5% of traffic first? prefer to avoid a full fleet restart until we confirm no regressions. I'll draft the runbook steps and post them here.

ops-bot: ALERT (11:23 UTC): p95 latency high for route `/generate` — region=us-east1, increase=+220ms over baseline. Incident id: INC-1787.

jack: trace link: https://traces.example/trace/abc123 — see long wait for `kv.evict` call (~1200ms). Also noticed a subtask queue backlog on batcher-2. I think eviction stall is the root cause for the tail.

morgan: flagged infra capacity team for a quick look at eviction throughput. pinged @infra on pager.

cheng: plan: 13:30 prep (runbook + rollback steps posted), 14:00 canary restart to 5% (batcher subset), monitor 14:00–14:20, if stable, ramp to 25% then full. Jack to validate traces post-canary. Riley to watch dashboards. Priya to post runbook. Morgan to coordinate infra if capacity adjustments needed.

priya: runbook draft posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/batcher-evict-canary — includes rollback: `kubectl rollout undo` steps, health checks, and alert thresholds. Please review.

riley: saw the runbook, minor nit on the prometheus query (I'll push a tiny fix).

cheng: thanks — no objections heard. Proceeding with prep. If anything pops before 13:30 please ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
